name: Minimalism Web
summary: A page with one idea per screen: few elements, much space, one type family and one accent. Every part must earn its place; what stays is clear, calm and fast.

philosophy.core_thesis: Remove until only the need is left: space and restraint carry the message.
design_principles: Show one idea, one action and one image or none per screen.
Use 60% to 75% of the surface as empty space; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 32, 64 and 128px.
Use one type family in 2 weights and a scale of 14, 16, 24 and 64px.
Set the page in white or off-white (#FAFAF8) with text in near-black (#161616) and one accent for the main action only.
Use no border, shadow or gradient; separate parts with space or a hairline of 1px at 12% opacity.
Keep navigation to 5 items or fewer and show no icon that has no clear meaning.
Animate only state changes, in 150ms to 250ms.
anti_patterns: Clutter of badges, icons and labels

layout.grid_mechanics: A single column or a 12-column grid with few filled columns; one block per screen section; 160px to 240px between sections.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 65% to 80% of the surface is empty.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush left with a strict left edge; one centred axis only for a hero; no mixed alignments.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangles with 0px to 4px radius; no frames; 1px hairlines only.

font_pairings.note: A soft geometric voice with open shapes.
A modern sans with calm, even rhythm.

hierarchy_rules: Set one headline per screen and keep it under 8 words.
Set labels at 12px in the muted colour.

color.palette_structure: White, near-black and one quiet accent.
color.contrast_rules: Ink on paper holds 17:1; the accent marks 1 action per screen and holds 4.5:1 for text.
color.surface_treatment: Flat fields with no gradient and no texture.
color.light_and_shadow: No shadow; depth comes from space and order.

materiality.surface_simulation: A matt, flat surface like white paper.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px hairline at 12% opacity, used rarely.

ornamentation_details.iconography: One outline icon set at 1.5px, used only where the word is unclear.
ornamentation_details.illustration: None, or a single photograph at full width with no frame.

motion.transition_physics: Quiet: short fades and 8px slides; no bounce; no loop; motion only confirms a change.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover underlines or darkens the accent by 8% in 150ms; active state shifts it 1px.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels calm, focused and free of noise.

use_cases: fintech and tools that need trust
avoid_when: The brand needs warmth, play or ornament.
The page must show a large catalogue at once.
The audience expects density and many options.

modifiers.how: Add a serif for headlines and a paper tint; keep the space.
Add a strict 12-column grid and a bold red accent.
Replace the grey by pastel haze and a light serif.

pack.why: A thin, neutral outline family that stays quiet next to plain type.

ground.why: Minimalism keeps the field almost empty: a faint dot grid and one small light of colour.

tailwind.classes: rounded bg-[#2F5BEA] px-6 py-3 font-semibold text-white transition-colors duration-150 hover:bg-[#1E3FB0]
